title: A note on probabilistic powerdomains, RB-domains, and bc-domains
summary: For a finite nonempty poset \(F\), the normalized probabilistic powerdomain \(\Vone(F)\) is an RB-domain exactly when \(F\) is a finite rooted tree. We extend this classification to arbitrary nonempty dcpos from the viewpoint of forbidden structure. The principal-ideal chain condition is expressed by the absence of a lower fork, i.e. a triple \((x,y,t)\) with \(x\leq t\), \(y\leq t\), and \(x\parallel y\).
